title: B-Perf: Black-box Performance Antipattern Detection Using System-level Execution Tracing

summary.core_contribution: B-Perf frames system-level execution traces as a basis for black-box performance-antipattern detection.
summary.problem: Black-box systems expose performance symptoms without revealing application internals, making antipattern detection difficult.
summary.method: The work uses system-level execution tracing as the observable signal for detecting performance antipatterns without requiring application instrumentation.
summary.findings: The paper presents a trace-based approach and evaluation for identifying performance antipatterns; exact rates and workload details require full-text review.

summary.future_work: Validate the detector across more operating systems, workloads, antipattern classes, and production environments.
